content: The results for this experiment are listed in the bottom row of Table TABREF39. An M-Bert model that learns target embeddings instead of encoding a question performs clearly worse in the supervised and cross-lingual settings. From this we conclude that spelled-out natural language questions provide important linguistic detail that can help in stance detection.
